items.program_name: 雇用創出税額控除(OH JCTC)
items.summary: オハイオ州Tax Credit AuthorityがSweep America Intermediate Holdings, LLCに対し、Seven Hills市のプロジェクトで72人の新規雇用創出(年間給与$3.42M)を条件に7年間1.208%の雇用創出税額控除(JCTC)を承認。
items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a Job Creation Tax Credit of 1.208% for 7 years on 2023-05-08 for a project in the City of Seven Hills, Cuyahoga County. Commitment: create 72 full-time equivalent employees generating $3,420,000 in new annual payroll at the project location.
